title: The list of tests over live data names every test that reads the live kb or backlog, wherever it lives
goal: test_kb_lookup's LIVE_DATA_TESTS names every test that reads the repository's live kb or backlog (the backlog tests now in test_bl_check.py and test_tool_closure.py among them), its completeness test scans every test file and also flags a read through Path(TOOLS).parent, not only the text cwd=KB, and kb/_self/code.md's 'lists each such test' is true; a planted unlisted live-data test fails it. Found by the SP-w3xmbdra review (ST-2zl2od7q's scan still covered only test_kb_lookup.py and test_backlog.py after the split).

run:
import glob,sys
d=open("kb/_self/code.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
assert "A test over the repository's live data holds at any size of it." in d, "rule gone"
claims="lists each such test" in d
listed=any("LIVE_DATA_TESTS" in open(f,encoding="utf-8").read() for f in glob.glob("_tools/test_*.py"))
assert not claims or listed, "code.md claims a list of live-data tests that no test file holds"
for f in glob.glob("_tools/test_*.py"):
    s=open(f,encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert "LIVE_DATA_TESTS" not in s or "def test_" in s
print("ok")
